extracted.intended_audience: electric cooperative leaders, NRECA members, and federal/state policymakers (Congress, DOE, USDA, regulators)
extracted.subtask_description: News/advocacy content framing policy positions and operational priorities for electric cooperatives on grid reliability, affordability, permitting, supply chains, and rural broadband. Intended to inform congressional testimony, regulatory engagement, and stakeholder outreach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reliability and affordability as core policy goals
rubrics_metrics.description: Press lawmakers to approach energy policy with affordability and reliability at the core: "Keeping the lights on and bolstering the rural American economy are goals that transcend party lines."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Policy decisions should prioritize ensuring sufficient resources to power homes and businesses tomorrow; advocacy should emphasize the centrality of affordable, reliable electricity for rural families and businesses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diverse energy mix
rubrics_metrics.description: "Diversity of electric generation is essential to our commitment to a lower carbon future." Co-ops should explore all options, technologies and ideas to meet evolving energy needs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support portfolios that include renewables alongside firm resources; emphasize that wind/solar can be important but must be complemented by other resources to ensure reliability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain always-available, dispatchable generation
rubrics_metrics.description: Always-available generation—nuclear, natural gas or coal—must remain essential elements of the generation portfolio: "You need to have always available, dispatchable resources to maintain the grid."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Policy and investment choices should preserve or replace baseload/dispatchable capacity to meet 24/7 demand; warn against relying solely on intermittent resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid premature, disorderly retirement of baseload plants
rubrics_metrics.description: Concerns about the 'disorderly retirement of baseload power plants' which reduces capacity as demand grows.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advocate for transition timelines and policies that account for reliability impacts and regional differences; discourage mandates that force rapid retirements without replacement capacity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expand generation and transmission capacity to meet decarbonization goals
rubrics_metrics.description: Reference to NREL finding that generation capacity would need to triple and transmission double or triple to reach a zero-carbon grid by 2035.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Policies must plan for significant build-out of generation and transmission; stress the scale and timeline implications when setting decarbonization targets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Streamline permitting and environmental review (NEPA reform)
rubrics_metrics.description: Call for meaningful reforms to the federal permitting process and modernization of NEPA to remove barriers and accelerate construction of energy infrastructure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recommend coordinated, consistent, and timely agency decision-making; preserve robust environmental protections while ensuring determinations are made in a timely manner to avoid costly delays and cancellations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accelerate multi-agency approvals (e.g., vegetation management)
rubrics_metrics.description: Advocate for accelerating approval of multi-agency permits for vegetation management that will help prevent wildfires.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support streamlined multi-agency coordination for specific, reliability-critical activities (like vegetation management) to reduce wildfire risk and outage vulnerabilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure timeliness in agency determinations
rubrics_metrics.description: Permitting and environmental reviews are often 'needlessly lengthened' by inconsistent reviews and decision delays, harming project timelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Policies and reforms should set processes and deadlines to prevent prolonged administrative delay; emphasize predictable timelines in permitting regimes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain robust environmental protections while speeding decisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Reform should 'maintain robust environmental protections while ensuring determinations are made in a timely manner.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Balance speed and environmental safeguards: craft procedural reforms that reduce duplication and litigation risk without removing substantive protections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access to federal funding and parity for co-ops (direct-pay tax incentives)
rubrics_metrics.description: Support for legislation providing direct-pay tax credits and direct federal payments so not-for-profit co-ops can access incentives that for-profit utilities historically received.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advocate for policy changes (e.g., direct-pay provisions in IRA and budget bills) that level the playing field so co-ops can invest in renewables, storage, nuclear, and carbon capture.

rubrics_metrics.name: Flexible financing and ability to refinance RUS loans
rubrics_metrics.description: Support for the Flexible Financing for Rural America Act to allow co-ops to refinance Rural Utilities Service loans without costly prepayment penalties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Argue that refinancing authority yields substantial member savings and improves co-ops' financial flexibility to invest in infrastructure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Streamline USDA ReConnect and other rural broadband programs for co-ops
rubrics_metrics.description: ReConnect program is 'unwieldly' and often designed for traditional telecom companies, making it difficult for small co-ops to navigate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recommend programmatic flexibility, reduced administrative burden, and tailoring requirements to the co-op business model to accelerate rural broadband deployment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expand rural broadband and ensure accurate FCC service maps
rubrics_metrics.description: Expand access to rural broadband and ensure the accuracy of FCC service maps so federal funds target projects that most efficiently close the digital divide.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Policies should improve data accuracy, so funding flows to underserved areas; co-ops should be eligible recipients of broadband funding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Address supply chain vulnerabilities for critical grid components
rubrics_metrics.description: Supply chain disruptions (transformers, conductor, poles, fiber) threaten reliability and recovery efforts; shortages have eroded reserve inventories and lengthened lead times.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support short-term measures (DPA invocation, stakeholder inclusion) and long-term investments in domestic manufacturing and workforce expansion to shorten lead times.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include all stakeholders in Defense Production Act and implementation processes
rubrics_metrics.description: NRECA urges 'inclusion of all stakeholders in the implementation process' of DPA actions to accelerate production of electric transformers and equipment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure cooperative utilities are represented in implementation planning so measures avoid unintended interruptions to grid operations and address sector needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collaborative industry-government initiatives (Tiger Team / ESCC)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use multi-stakeholder groups (Electricity Subsector Coordinating Council Tiger Team) to share operational expertise, identify alternative vendors, and recommend government solutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Promote regular, structured collaboration across co-ops, IOUs, public power, manufacturers, and federal agencies to address shortages and logistical challenges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Target investments to improve grid resilience across generation, T&D
rubrics_metrics.description: Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act programs offer funding to build resilience on generation and transmission and distribution sides of the system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advocate using federal infrastructure funds for resilience projects, including hardening assets, adding redundancy, and investing in storage and modernization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prioritize prevention of outages during peak demand and extreme weather
rubrics_metrics.description: NERC assessments warn of greater risk as demand grows and extreme weather events increase; policy must address capacity reductions and growing peak demand.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support planning, capacity resources, and emergency preparedness measures that reduce the likelihood and impact of peak-driven outages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promote realistic timelines and regional flexibility for energy transitions
rubrics_metrics.description: Oppose mandates that 'mandate energy sector transformations over unreasonable or unrealistic timelines' and ignore regional differences in resource availability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Policy design should allow regional tailoring, phased transitions, and technology-readiness considerations to avoid stranded assets and reliability gaps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure co-op operational/financial models are considered in program design
rubrics_metrics.description: Many federal programs and tax structures are not designed for not-for-profit co-ops (e.g., tax-credit structure prevents direct benefit to co-ops).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Modify program rules and application processes to account for cooperative ownership structures, small staff sizes, and local business models.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preserve member affordability, especially for end-of-line rural households
rubrics_metrics.description: Co-ops sell the majority of their power to households; keeping rates down for rural families at the end of the line is especially important.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advocacy should stress cost impacts on member-owners and promote policies (financing, tax parity, targeted grants) that limit rate increases.
